natureza: Duas ilustrações interpretativas, sem escala ou localização exata. A tempestade, a passagem rochosa, o trajeto e as pessoas são construções visuais; os custos de travessia vêm do modelo cartográfico, não das estampas.

imagens.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: first image of a paired interactive comparison in an editorial atlas website about fictional Arrakis. Create a NEW ORIGINAL image, a wide landscape monochrome sepia photogravure plate, 3:2 or 16:10, no lettering. Scene: one immense Coriolis sandstorm crosses a desert plain at dusk; viewed from a Fremen shelter inside a low weathered rocky ridge. The foreground is protected behind dark sandstone fins and a shallow natural passage, with a single tiny robed traveller for human scale, face unseen, no logos, no film costume references. Beyond the rocky opening, a vast dust wall and the same distinctive forked rock spire on the far horizon, the storm lit by low sun. Sober natural-history expedition print, warm brown ink on pale ivory, precise fine stipple and delicate engraved hatching, tactile stone and sand, subtle depth, quiet archival atmosphere rather than action-movie spectacle. Strong legibility at mobile size; rock framing prominent, storm prominent beyond, horizon at upper third. Composition should be suitable for comparison with a second image from an Imperial exposed route toward that same forked spire and storm; preserve a consistent horizon and storm direction. Interpretive illustration without geographic measurements. No arrows, maps, words, labels, title, legend, border, watermark, signature, machinery, weapons, architecture, worms, or sand sails.
